prompts.light_air:
FRAME FORMAT: Preserve the existing eighteen-object sheet, SIX columns × THREE rows, fixed centered cells, even transparent padding, same relative scale and overhead camera.
PRECISE BACKGROUND EXTRACTION / SMALL PAINT CORRECTION of the attached existing sheet. Retain all EIGHTEEN finished sprites, exact shapes, row/column order, colors, outlines, rivets, details and proportions. Do not redesign, merge or drop objects.
REMOVE ALL colored glow, haze, fog, gradients, shadows and background pixels between and behind the sprites. These are game sprite cutouts: the alpha outside each solid mechanical outline must be ZERO. Clean crisp silhouettes, no semitransparent colored halo and no rectangular alpha backdrop around any object. Preserve actual solid black outline pixels. Transparent alpha is essential, not a dark painted backdrop or a checkerboard texture.
Keep all existing palette identities unchanged.
The finished export must contain only the exact complete opaque mechanical modules with genuinely transparent surrounding spaces. NO background, NO glow, NO haze, NO shadows, NO text, NO labels.
